name: manual_11da58
claim: Adding an automatic start of an exposure path (a TLS front end, a listener) to a code path that skipped the exposure preflight bypasses its authentication checks. Apply the same preconditions before starting (insecure dev mode off, a strong control-plane token), never generate credentials after dependent services have started, and state what is not checked (a portal already running before the launch).

decisions.notes: A review caught that the plain-launch autostart skipped the LAN auth preflight; the gate and tests were added in orama PR 491.
